sources.title: Sketchfab
sources.snippet: Use Sketchfab to publish, share and embed interactive 3D files. Discover and download thousands of 3D models from games, cultural heritage, architecture, design and more.

sources.title: Yeggi — 3D Printing Search Engine for STL Models
sources.snippet: Yeggi is the search engine for 3D printable models. Search Yeggi to find and download STL files and 3D printing models aggregated from across the web.

sources.title: CivArchive (CivitAI Archive) - AI Model Archive
sources.snippet: Browse and discover AI models from CivitAI, TensorArt, and SeaArt. Community-driven archive preserving access to AI resources.

sources.snippet: Chat with millions of AI Characters on the #1 AI chat app. Where will your next adventure take you?

sources.title: Civitai | Discover and Create AI Art
sources.snippet: Explore thousands of free Stable Diffusion & Flux models, create and share AI-generated art, and join the world's largest community of generative AI creators.
